jobs_results.title: Machine Learning Intern
jobs_results.description:
About the Role


Passion3DWorld is seeking a motivated and talented Machine Learning Engineer Intern to join our technical team. This remote, flexible internship is designed for students who are recently graduated or currently enrolled in college who are eager to apply and expand their skills in machine learning and software development. You will work directly with our experienced team, gaining hands-on experience in a real-world setting.


Passion3DWorld provides world-class enterprise specific solutions in the overlapping sections of Robotics, AI/ML, and 3D Printing.


What You'll Do



 Contribute to Software Development: Assist in the design, development, and implementation of new software solutions.
 Data and Model Management: Help with data collection, pre-processing, and database creation. You will also assist in fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) and other machine learning projects.
 Backend Development: Learn and contribute to API creation and backend development to support new applications.
 Testing and Debugging: Collaborate with the team to test, debug, and ensure the reliability of software solutions.
 Documentation: Create clear and concise documentation for new software applications and processes.
 Team Collaboration: Attend meetings and work with other team members to contribute to a collaborative and innovative environment.

Qualifications



 Recently graduated or Currently enrolled in a college or university program.
 A strong interest in machine learning, software development, and related technologies.
 Eagerness to learn new skills and adapt to changing project needs.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Job Type: Internship


Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month


Benefits:



 Paid time off
 Work from home

Work Location: Remote

jobs_results.title: PhD Intern - Machine Learning Researcher
jobs_results.description: PhD Intern, Machine Learning: MSI, Product Operations Team Summary Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Every single day, people do amazing things at Apple. This position involves a wide variety of skills, innovation, and is a rare opportunity to be working on groundbreaking, new applications of machine learning, research, and implementation. Ultimately, your work would have a huge impact on billions of users across the globe. You can help inspire change, by using your skills to influence globally recognized products' manufacturing. Description The goal of Apple's Manufacturing and Operations team is to take a vision of a product and turn it into a reality. Through the use of statistics, the scientific process, and machine learning, the team recommends and implements solutions to the most challenging problems. We're looking for ML researchers to help us revolutionize how we manufacture Apple's amazing products. Put your skill & passion to work in this highly visible role. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with applying Machine Learning, especially Computer Vision in a Manufacturing / Assembly setting Familiarity with multimodal understanding & reasoning, knowledge-graphs & generative video models Prior publications in relevant field Minimum Qualifications Pursuing PhD in Computer Science / related field Deep understanding of Machine Learning concepts, Probability and Statistics Understanding of Computer Vision & VLMs, with demonstrated skill in training models and applying them to ML application development. Ability to prototype research ideas as working code (Python) Ability to meaningfully present results of analysis in a clear and impactful manner Experience Level Entry Level
